english.note: This is the all-purpose word for a magazine as a periodical publication.
Use this for a general magazine or subject-focused periodical rather than a scholarly publication.

examples.english: I buy that travel magazine every month.
examples.traditional: 我每個月都買嗰本旅遊雜誌。
